description:
Enhance the security of the 'SecureNotes' app by migrating the 'TokenManager' class from standard SharedPreferences to Jetpack Security's EncryptedSharedPreferences.

1. Add the 'androidx.security:security-crypto' dependency (version 1.0.0 or higher) to the app-level build.gradle.kts.
2. In 'app/src/main/java/com/example/securenotes/data/TokenManager.kt', refactor the code to use 'EncryptedSharedPreferences'.
3. Create a MasterKey using 'MasterKey.Builder'.
4. Initialize the shared preferences using 'EncryptedSharedPreferences.create' with the filename 'secure_app_prefs'.
5. Use 'AES256_SIV' for key encryption and 'AES256_GCM' for value encryption.
6. Run the unit tests (TokenManagerTest) to verify that saving and retrieving tokens still works correctly.
